help.stepVitalsText: Save HR, RR, BP, SatO₂ and temperature; the system calculates risk.
help.stepSbarText: Document situation, background, assessment and shift recommendation.
help.stepReportsText: Consolidate patients, alerts, events, SBAR and audit data into a clinical report.

help.stepAlertsText: Prioritize active alerts and complete the actions allowed for your role.
help.stepEventsText: Review and register the clinical progression linked to each patient.

vitals.validation.bloodPressure: Systolic pressure must be greater than diastolic pressure.
